page.layout: One printed page: running head "EMBLEMA" at top centre with page number "16" at top left; title heading in large italic capitals beneath, continued on second line; a copperplate emblem engraving in a framed box in the centre; a verse motto of four lines in italic below the engraving; catchword "Fie" at lower right.

main_text.head: INGENIVM VERÆ AC SALUIFICÆ FIDEI.
main_text.l: Perpetuas tibi fundit aquas fons viuus, & vsum
Sic fidei veræ soboles dilectio præsto est,
Corpus vt vmbra, fidem sic comitatur amor.

page.notes: The engraving shows an angel and a child-like figure above clouds, a flaming heart over a chalice, and below a grotto-like arch with three flowers over a basin, with a spring/fountain and a small pipe at the bottom. The engraving is not transcribed as text. The title's second line reads "uificæ fidei." in italic, with the hyphenated word "SAL-" split at the line end. The catchword "Fie" is printed at lower right.
